h: h3: A new safety benchmark in Sarawak
h2: What thirty-one years have proved.
h2: Tell us what you are building.
ledes: Founded in Malaysia in 1995 by Ir. Tiew Soon Aik, IAQ began as a cleanroom specialist and now delivers hi-tech facilities end to end, from design to maintenance.

The company started locally and is now global. Its footprint covers Singapore, Sweden, Poland, France, India and Germany, and it is still expanding. Globally IAQ grows as a cleanroom specialist. Regionally it operates as a total solutions provider: one accountable team from the first drawing to final handover, and then for the life of the facility.
Drawn to scale: one tick for each of the 31 years. Achievements carry IAQ’s own newsroom photographs. Any image that is not the project itself is labelled a representation.
Each is on record in IAQ’s company profile, its newsroom or the project registry.
Feasibility to handover, one accountable team. Response in a working day.
